claims.claim_ar: فيه وَجْهَانِ: إمَّا أنْ يكونَ «العَلِيمُ» خَبَرًا ثانٍ لِـ«وَهُوَ»، وإمَّا نَعْتٌ لِـ«السَّمِيعِ»
claims.claim_en: There are two possible analyses (wajh): either "al-ʿAlīm" is a second khabar (predicate) of "wa-huwa", or it is a naʿt (adjective) describing "as-Samīʿ".
claims.needs_review_reason: The provided source notes that some phrases admit multiple وجهات (analyses) but does not state explicitly which of the two analyses applies to this particular phrase; requires confirmation from a direct comment on this exact wording or from additional grammatical sources.
